INTEGRATED SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg.

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory apparatus and instruments? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory apparatus and instruments.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory apparatus and instruments.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Reproductive System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Reproductive System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Reproductive System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Reproductive System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Reproductive System.

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Indicators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Human Reproductive System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System 18 4.0 Force and Energy 4.1 Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Human Excretory System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Energy 18 4.2 Magnetism 16 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sugg and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
